title.zh: Meta ordered to pay $25B penalty in New Mexico Cambridge Analytica case
title.en: Meta ordered to pay $25B penalty in New Mexico Cambridge Analytica case

current_state.zh: New Mexico's Attorney General secured a historic $25 billion penalty against Meta in litigation tied to the Cambridge Analytica scandal, a decision Meta is widely expected to appeal.
